title: Port the full EPP browser shell and navigation
goal: Replace the seed-only document list with the full EPP browser shell, grouped nav, document/navigation search, library selector, document routing, and Appendix A visibility.
acceptance_criteria: SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, so workspaces/epp-full/source-files is physically absent from the app-facing workspace
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, so project/catalog.json is normalized app-facing metadata and no raw upstream catalog copy with development-only source paths is retained

SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, so app-facing project metadata no longer exposes development-only original office/catalog source paths through crosswalks, source metadata, search metadata, compliance metadata, or service responses
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, so app-facing workspace metadata does not expose absolute local paths to the original EPP source checkout
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, so development-only original source annotations are not exposed as app-facing extracted context
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, including the automated post-import leak check for disallowed original-source markers
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, including a passing reference-integrity check for retained app-facing metadata
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, so workspace summaries use explicit provenance and retained-regulatory source counts instead of a generic source_count
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete without resetting audit ledger, workbook state, draft workbook state, or runtime data
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete, so import audit events are sanitized and do not retain raw source paths, development-only source filenames, browse targets, or download targets
SG-0007 import cleanup is complete through validated staging-and-promotion, so SG-0013 reads only the promoted live epp-full workspace
The app reads full EPP workspace manifests, document metadata, and document payloads through the local service instead of static seed imports
The local service provides browser-ready navigation and document-read contracts, while the React app owns presentation and filtering

Document-read endpoints return browser-ready rendered compatibility output from current canonical source, plus sanitized metadata, stable anchors, source/compliance orientation, and artifact placeholder/context data
React consumes service-rendered compatibility output for normal browsing and owns shell, navigation, selected-document state, filtering, and reader controls
The browser uses canonical EPP documents plus retained regulatory sources, and does not expose development-only source-files or original source-file paths as app content
Document source metadata may show non-browseable original-source provenance stubs, but original source records do not provide open, browse, download, or retained-file affordances
If the local service is unavailable, the app shows a clear service-required state with retry instead of silently falling back to the seed fixture
When `epp-full` is available, the app opens directly into the full EPP browser rather than a workspace picker, seed fixture, or neutral home screen
The left nav exposes the EPP display groups and counts from the old browser
Every imported `epp-full` document is reachable somewhere in the app, with unmapped documents placed in a quiet fallback group instead of disappearing
Selected documents have stable document-level URLs using workspace ID and document ID, and normal back/forward browsing works
Appendices can be expanded and Appendix A can be opened as a normal document
Survey Guidance and CFR layers are represented in the library selector
One shared browser shell uses the library selector to change the visible grouped navigation for Emergency Preparedness Program, Survey Guidance, and CFR
Switching library layers keeps the current document selected only when it belongs to the target layer; otherwise it selects that layer's default first document
Navigation groups expand around the active document during the session without persisting expansion state across reloads
Navigation ordering honors browser navigation overrides when present and uses a stable deterministic fallback for unmapped documents
The UI follows the old DOVAXIS/EPP document-first layout baseline
Documents with artifact blocks remain browseable, using source-aware placeholders when specialized renderer parity is out of scope
Search filters or locates documents from navigation metadata without attempting full-content search in this slice
Navigation counts show total documents by default and filtered counts or x-of-y context while a search query is active
Bookmarks, History, and Settings are visible shell affordances without real persistence, history inspection, or configuration workflows
Export or Download affordances may be visible as placeholders, but export generation is deferred
Markdown editing affordances may be visible as placeholders, but real edit mode, draft autosave, formatting controls, and review queues are deferred
Workbook, history, audit, assistant, and edit affordances are small reader/header placeholders rather than a dominant right-side inspector pane
Appendix A shows an attached HVA workbook entry point without requiring scoring, sidecar writes, print/export, or Appendix J workflows
Document masthead metadata gives lightweight source/compliance orientation without full relationship traversal
Reader output is rendered enough for real browsing rather than raw Markdown, while polished Markdown/CFR/compliance/artifact parity is deferred
non_goals: Full inline editing
Markdown edit mode, draft autosave, formatting toolbar, or draft review queue
Full HVA scoring UI
Workbook sidecar state writes, print/export output, or Appendix J linkage workflows
Final renderer parity for every artifact
Full compliance graph traversal, backlink ranking, related-document UI, or rich CFR/E-tag relationship browsing
Polished Markdown parity, inline CFR citation linking, full eCFR indentation, compliance popovers, specialized artifact panels, or editing-aware section wrappers
Persistent third-column inspector layout for workbook, history, audit, assistant, or edit workflows
Export/download generation, print packets, PDFs, zip bundles, or current-document export
Full-content search across document bodies
Returning only raw Markdown as the primary normal-reader payload
Rebuilding the full old Markdown, CFR, compliance, and artifact renderer in React during SG-0013
Bookmark persistence, history inspection, or settings configuration workflows
Workspace-picker flow or last-opened document persistence
Heading-level permalink persistence, saved user browsing history, or complex router state
Separate last-selected document state per library layer
Persisted group expansion/collapse state
Manual document ordering hard-coded in React
Treating the old browser's represented document set as the only browseable corpus
React reading raw workspace/project files directly for primary browser behavior
Reading or exposing raw upstream catalog copies with development-only original source paths
Reading or exposing unsanitized project metadata containing development-only original office/catalog source paths
Reading or exposing development-only original source annotations as app-facing extracted context
Silently ignoring dangling source/document references in service responses
Displaying or depending on a generic source_count that blurs retained regulatory sources with provenance-only records
Displaying absolute local original-source checkout paths in app-facing workspace metadata or service responses
Silent fallback to `epp-seed` when the service or `epp-full` is unavailable
Separate standalone navigation shells or app views for each library layer
Browsing, downloading, or retaining development-only original source-files as app workspace content
Opening or downloading original office/catalog source files from provenance stubs
Treating SG-0007 import refresh as a reset of app-owned review, workbook, draft, or runtime state
Reading or displaying raw import diagnostics that contain development-only source paths
Discovering or browsing SG-0007 staging import candidates as app workspaces
Mobile layout
validation: Smoke /api/workspaces, /api/workspaces/epp-full, /api/workspaces/epp-full/navigation, and document-read endpoints against epp-full
Run a repeatable desktop browser smoke or screenshot check that proves the full nav appears
Open the Appendix A document URL directly
Expand Appendices and open Appendix A from the nav
Switch to Survey Guidance and CFR and open one document from each library layer
Verify the service-unavailable state is clear and retryable
Confirm the SG-0007 post-import leak check is passing before using epp-full service responses
Confirm the SG-0007 post-cleanup reference-integrity check is passing before using epp-full service responses
Confirm epp-full service responses use explicit source count labels rather than generic source_count
Confirm epp-full service responses do not expose absolute local original-source checkout paths
Confirm SG-0007 refresh did not reset audit ledger, workbook state, draft workbook state, or runtime data before browser work
Confirm SG-0007 import audit events do not contain raw source paths, development-only source filenames, browse targets, or download targets
Confirm SG-0013 service discovery does not expose SG-0007 staging import candidates as workspaces
Confirm document-read responses include browser-ready rendered compatibility output, sanitized metadata, stable anchors, and artifact/source/compliance context
Confirm the normal reader does not depend on a raw-Markdown-only service payload

changed_surfaces: service document reads return service-rendered HTML, stable anchors, sanitized document metadata, source/compliance orientation, and artifact context
src/lib/archivistApi.ts adds typed local-service reads for status, workspace summaries, navigation, and documents
src/main.tsx now opens epp-full directly through the service and owns the grouped shell, library selector, search, document routes, reader controls, and Appendix A artifact entry
src/styles.css now supports the full document-first browser layout, grouped navigation, service-required state, orientation panels, artifact entry, and rendered document content

validation_commands.evidence: Navigation returned 261 documents across Emergency Preparedness Program (177), Survey Guidance (52), and CFR (32).
Appendix A returned rendered HTML, one stable anchor, five source references, one compliance reference, and the hva-workbook-v1 artifact context.
Survey Guidance document returned rendered HTML and anchors.
CFR document returned rendered HTML and anchors.

evidence: Headless Chrome screenshot captured Appendix A direct URL at .tmp/sg-0013/appendix-a.png with grouped navigation, Appendix A selected, and the HVA workbook entry point visible.
Headless Chrome screenshot captured Survey Guidance direct URL at .tmp/sg-0013/survey-guidance.png.
Headless Chrome screenshot captured CFR direct URL at .tmp/sg-0013/cfr.png.
Headless Chrome screenshot captured service-required retry state at .tmp/sg-0013/service-required.png after temporarily stopping the local service.
The epp-full navigation service default opens Policy and Organizational Statements and retains manifest ordering inside deterministic browser groups.
The Appendix A document remains a normal document route and reports artifact_count 1 in navigation metadata.
The missing Evacuation Floor Plans manifest entry remains reachable and returns a clear missing-Markdown reader payload instead of disappearing from navigation.
residual_risks: Markdown rendering is intentionally compatibility-level; polished CFR indentation, citation linking, compliance popovers, and specialized artifact renderer parity remain deferred.
Bookmark, history, settings, recommendation, export, and review-lock controls are visible placeholders only.
The HVA workbook entry point expands local context only; scoring, sidecar writes, print/export, and Appendix J linkage remain deferred.
Source orientation labels are sanitized provenance stubs derived from source ids, not browsable retained source records.

notes: This should come before deeper workbook UI polish because workbook affordances need to attach to visible documents. SG-0002 is absorbed here so the browser shell is built on the durable local service boundary from the start. SG-0007 is now a prerequisite so the browser build starts from a promoted cleaned app-facing workspace where development-only source-files are physically absent, project metadata is app-facing and sanitized, original source annotations are not exposed as app-facing extracted context, original catalog sources are provenance-only, absolute local source checkout paths are hidden from app-facing metadata, dangling references fail validation, source counts are explicit, regulatory sources remain retained, app-owned audit/workbook/draft/runtime state survives import refresh, import audit events are sanitized, and staging import candidates are not discoverable app workspaces. The SG-0013 document-read endpoint should return service-rendered compatibility output so React can focus on shell, navigation, and controls instead of rebuilding the full renderer. Full artifact renderer parity is deferred, but renderer gaps must not prevent the user from browsing the real corpus in the app.
